# Places of the Gold Country — locations.fiddletowngazette.com

This repo serves the Places / locations database viewer at https://locations.fiddletowngazette.com.

**GENERATED — do not edit files here.** The single source of truth is `locations.html` in the
[gold-country-events](https://github.com/davedellaquila/gold-country-events) repo (which also serves
the page at events.fiddletowngazette.com/locations.html). Publish changes by running
`sync-locations.sh` in that repo; it copies the page and the places icon assets here byte-for-byte
and verifies the copies match, so the two addresses can never drift.
